Canonical source fingerprints normalize relative paths to POSIX separators.
Canonical source fingerprint file ordering is platform-independent.
CI, pre-freeze qualification and full certification share the canonical fingerprint utility.
Windows and macOS G14 must verify one exact source fingerprint from one exact source ZIP.
macOS native audit invocation must not depend on upload-preserved executable metadata.
Smart Router v2 and Rapid Move runtime behavior are inherited unchanged.
Protected deterministic Day/Swing/Long formulas remain unchanged.
v17.5.1 Stable remains isolated and untouched.
Embedded renderer/auth resource paths use platform-neutral embedded-FS path semantics on every OS.
Real-Application tests isolate the effective os.UserConfigDir location on Linux, macOS and Windows.
Stable-to-TEST profile migration tests derive the same OS-specific config base used by production.
Windows file-permission tests do not misinterpret os.FileMode as Windows ACL evidence.
Windows G14 uses explicit PowerShell path/value binding for the Stable sentinel.
Canonical source fingerprint remains platform-independent and unchanged in ownership.
Smart Router v2 and Rapid Move runtime behavior are inherited unchanged.
Protected deterministic Day/Swing/Long formulas and the No Execution Boundary remain unchanged.
v17.5.1 Stable remains isolated and untouched.
Real-Application tests close the persistence backend before temporary profile cleanup on every OS.
Windows native tests must not fail because an open SQLite handle survives until t.TempDir cleanup.
Native G14 release identity verifies the canonical api/health buildId field rather than a nonexistent build field.
Native G14 continues to require exact source ZIP SHA-256 and canonical source fingerprint on macOS and Windows.
Smart Router v2 and Rapid Move production behavior are inherited unchanged.
Protected deterministic Day/Swing/Long formulas and the No Execution Boundary remain unchanged.
v17.5.1 Stable remains isolated and untouched.
v18.0.3 remains an immutable failed native candidate and is never silently rewritten.
Tracked Symbols is the user-facing cross-desk symbol surface; implementation-facing Master Symbol Store wording is removed from the active user panel.
Cross-desk add/remove/remove-all mutations have one canonical helper path and preserve explicit-empty state across reload/restart.
Remove All includes symbols in disabled desks, clears Day/Swing/Long immediately, leaves Discovery staging untouched, and cannot silently rehydrate defaults.
Opportunity Radar keeps existing intelligence semantics while improving column hierarchy, numeric alignment, status pills, actions and narrow-width reflow.
Research Target alone is compacted; Technical Context and all existing Research evidence views remain intact.
USER and DEMO surfaces hide Data Engine/provider/subscription/capacity/queue/cache/scheduler/database/circuit/policy machinery and receive user-meaningful Data Status instead.
OWNER, SUPER_OWNER and ADMIN retain deep diagnostics in Maintenance and configuration surfaces.
MacBook, Windows desktop, large-screen and narrow/iPad layouts must not clip or overlap touched controls.
Protected deterministic Day/Swing/Long formulas remain unchanged.
v18.1 multi-user/My Market Symbols architecture is explicitly out of scope.
v18.0.4 Stable remains immutable; TEST uses an isolated v18.0.5 runtime profile.
Reuse the existing Smart Provider Router v2 and canonical provider reconciliation; no second routing or reconciliation owner.
Capability/entitlement states, per-capability circuits/cooldowns, latency and calls-avoided telemetry remain owned by the existing Router v2 foundation.
Provider Router SourceDisagreements must reflect canonical contemporaneous reconciliation CONFLICT truth without extra provider calls or duplicate storage.
Rapid Move remains the single event detector and gains explicit RAPID_MOVE versus MARKET_SHOCK classification from existing correlated market context.
Already-alerted Rapid Move states use bounded hysteresis so small retracements cannot thrash CONFIRMED/EXTENDED events back to EARLY/VALIDATING.
Deduped observations preserve the original provider event and window anchors so 1m/5m/20m outcomes remain point-in-time truthful under busy live updates.
Rapid Move adaptive learning is explicitly SHADOW with SHADOW → VALIDATED → APPROVED → PRODUCTION governance and no automatic policy promotion.
Outcome scorecards distinguish continued, reversed and faded/mixed outcomes and count market-shock alerts/hysteresis retention for Adaptive Intelligence evaluation.
Opportunity Radar and Smart Notifications reuse the existing canonical promotion path with MARKET SHOCK semantics when applicable; protected scoring formulas are not changed.
Coverage remains truthful TIERED_PARTIAL and no full-market surveillance claim is introduced.
Performance remains event-first and fetch-once/reuse; the hardening adds no broad polling, provider fan-out or raw tick warehousing.
No Execution Boundary and protected deterministic Day/Swing/Long formulas remain unchanged; v18.1 multi-user architecture is out of scope.
Personal market state has one durable UserWorkspace owner keyed by immutable authenticated UserID.
The pre-v18.1 single-user Stable market state migrates exactly once into bootstrap OWNER workspace without data loss.
A newly authenticated user starts with an empty personal tracked/watchlist state and cannot inherit another user workspace.
Tracked Symbols, desk membership, watchlists, scope and selected ticker mutations affect only the requesting user workspace.
Profile export/import and AI default context use only the requesting user workspace; secrets remain excluded from export.
Bootstrap/state/runtime/quote/news/earnings/filing delivery is workspace-filtered so personal symbol ownership is not leaked across sessions.
Provider credentials, provider policy, global runtime settings and deterministic scoring configuration remain shared ADMIN-owned operational state.
Provider fetching, canonical evidence, Router v2, Rapid Move, Radar and deterministic scoring remain one shared canonical backend core.
The engine processing universe is the deduplicated union of user-required symbols; duplicate user interest never creates duplicate provider/scoring pipelines.
Removing a symbol from one workspace cannot remove it from the canonical processing universe while another workspace still requires it.
Broad-market Opportunity Radar and Rapid Move / Market Shock remain shared intelligence surfaces; personal watchlist isolation does not hide market-wide intelligence.
Persistence support covers SQLite and fallback backends and survives restart/reload with user ownership intact.
v18.1 TEST uses an isolated runtime profile cloned from v18.0.6 Stable on first run without writing into Stable.
v18.2 user administration, presence and session lifecycle UI/API is explicitly excluded from v18.1.
Protected deterministic Day/Swing/Long formulas and the permanent No Execution Boundary remain unchanged.
